desc: Cross-q full-basis loss floors at the IDENTICAL protocol (n=5, K=3, dist=3, L=16 a2a MS, full closure basis, full batch, best-of-3 seeds, 2000 steps). NOT directly comparable across q as an absolute code-quality number (basis size and closure grow with q; all points are L=16 capacity/step-capped values, not converged); the figure exists to make the previously-uncompared floors visible WITH those caveats attached.

q3_protocol_references.note: deeper q=3 protocol/depth references (headline_p05_Lsweep) showing the floors are protocol+capacity values, not intrinsic
